text: ふん　おまえは　ここで　あいつらと　なかよく　やってろよ！

structure.jp: あいつらと　なかよく
structure.en: on friendly terms with those guys

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action keeps going on; in casual speech the い drops. As an order, やっていろ becomes やってろ = 'go on doing it'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending (ろ on some verbs, an え-sound on others) is a blunt order. なかよく やってろ = 'you just keep being pals with them!'.
